headline: Dave Kendall, Creator and Host of MTV’s ‘120 Minutes,’ Dies at 63
context: With his English accent and ubiquitous leather jacket, Mr. Kendall was the face of alternative music on MTV from 1989 to 1992.

sources.name: The New York Times
